model.primary: county certified hours, Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood, county and former-region-by-period effects, two periods per contrast. With a state-level dose this is equivalent to the size-weighted state contrast used in the pre-checks.
secondary_outcomes: certified positions and hours per 2011 farm worker with equal county weights (the Track 1 declared primary, for continuity)
model.sample: all counties with positive 2011 farm employment in multi-state former AEWR regions, excluding AK, HI and DC (46 states)
model.post_ruling_cases: not separated (user decision). A declared sensitivity drops cases received on or after 2026-09-02, the start of the backpay period, wherever a window contains both kinds.
model.inference: state leave-one-out jackknife primary; state CRV1 and randomization inference permuting state doses within former region also reported (as in amendment 1)
model.first_stage: hours-weighted offered hourly wage on the dose, same effects, reported for every contrast

open_decisions.question: Whether to report a pooled C1-and-C2 estimate at all.
open_decisions.recommendation: No. Report C1 and C2 side by side: the mean of two seasons is no more precise than the first season alone in the placebo years, and the two answer different horizons.

design_stage_precision.C1_realized: elasticity MDE 1.12 for PPML hours and 0.90 for PPML positions (state jackknife; markdowns/alternative_identification_exploration.md section 3)
design_stage_precision.placebo_years: Within-region, size-weighted placebo error over FY2018-FY2025 gives 2.8 x RMSE of 0.41 (hours) and 0.45 (positions); with eight placebo years the 95% range of that figure is roughly 0.28 to 0.79. It is not a size-validated MDE.
design_stage_precision.expectation: No window available before a replacement rule adds usable precision. Only an event with within-region dispersion comparable to E1 could bring the size-valid MDE near 0.5.

rejected_at_design_stage.idea: use the between-region part of the cut with trend, lagged-growth or factor adjustments
rejected_at_design_stage.result: Size-weighted, the unadjusted full dose carries a placebo bias of about -0.30 elasticity units; trend removal plus two factor loadings leaves -0.13 to -0.22. Placebo error is 0.51 to 0.97 against 0.41 to 0.45 within region (full_cut_placebo_summary.csv).
